target: Original international Game Gear retail cartridge, product 02530 version 0

areas.name: Before Starting
areas.location_cue: the cartridge boot, title screen, character selector, and opening practice terrain
areas.note: Confirm the selected handheld build and learn every shared or character-specific tool before preserving route states.

save_backup.title: Create separate Sonic and Tails states
save_backup.why: The cartridge has no modern campaign save and the two routes must remain independently reproducible.
save_backup.detail: Save at the character selector and again at clean act boundaries. Label character, zone, act, and emerald count; never overwrite the only state before a one-use box.

levels.1: Begin with the preserved handheld release.
levels.2: Use the international Game Gear cartridge labelled Sonic Triple Trouble.
levels.3: Verify a 524,288-byte ROM with SHA-1 4965AF7FFE60382FFA805710B7C8006419CC4AC4. This is product 02530, version 0; exclude beta images and the Japanese-title duplicate from this selected route.

levels.1: One character favours direct speed and rolling attacks.
levels.2: Choose Sonic at the character screen and begin a clean route.
levels.3: Keep this state separate from Tails. Use Spin Dash for breakable floors and curves, Air Roll for airborne contact, and Super Peel Out when the forward lane is already safe.

levels.1: The second character can bypass selected vertical obstacles.
levels.2: Choose Tails at the character screen and begin a separate route.
levels.3: Use the shared Spin Dash and Air Roll normally, but reserve limited flight for high ledges, tiny-platform crossings, and recovery from awkward launches. Land before the flight timer expires.

levels.1: Breakable terrain often yields to a charged start.
levels.2: Hold Down, tap an action button, then release Down.
levels.3: Charge while stationary, release toward open ground, and jump only after momentum is established. Use it for weak blocks and curved walls; never launch blindly toward pits or retracting spikes.

levels.1: A second airborne input changes vulnerable contact.
levels.2: Jump, then press an action button again while airborne.
levels.3: The brief rolling window lets you strike enemies or extend a rebound. Time the second press shortly before contact; it works once per bounce and ends quickly, so repeated button mashing is unreliable.

levels.1: Sonic has a standing acceleration option.
levels.2: Hold Up, charge with an action button, then release Up.
levels.3: Use it only on a visible straight. It produces immediate ground speed without Spin Dash protection, so cancel the idea when an enemy, wall, water edge, or blind drop sits ahead.

levels.1: Short vertical freedom opens safer alternate lines.
levels.2: Jump as Tails, then press an action button repeatedly.
levels.3: Gain height with measured presses, steer toward the landing, and touch ground before trying again. Use flight to bypass tiny ledges or preserve fragile platforms, not to hover indefinitely.

levels.1: A fast temporary gadget rewards a clear launch lane.
levels.2: Break the Sonic-only rocket-footwear monitor in open terrain.
levels.3: Aim before collecting it because propulsion begins immediately. Steer through the intended high route, avoid fighting the forced momentum, and expect the gadget to end after its timed run or disruptive contact.

levels.1: One underwater tool replaces slow ordinary movement.
levels.2: Find Sonic's propeller-footwear monitor inside Tidal Plant.
levels.3: Enter the water route first, collect the monitor, then steer through submerged passages while the effect lasts. It improves underwater travel but does not remove the need to watch air and collision hazards.

levels.1: Snowy slopes contain a dedicated travel device.
levels.2: Collect Sonic's board monitor near a winter slope.
levels.3: Take the board only when the downhill lane is readable, centre it before jumps, and avoid hard obstacle contact. A hit ends the ride, so use ordinary movement for careful emerald-box work when necessary.

levels.1: A portable bounce tool reaches otherwise isolated ledges.
levels.2: Break the Pogo Spring monitor before a high crossing.
levels.3: Control horizontal movement during each bounce and land centrally on tiny platforms. Sonic needs this for one emerald-box route; Tails can often fly, but should still demonstrate the gadget once.

levels.1: Tails receives a vehicle for submerged combat.
levels.2: Collect the Tails-only submarine monitor in Tidal Plant.
levels.3: Stay near the upper-left during the submerged encounter and fire forward. Your shots damage the target and can intercept higher projectiles; direct contact can knock Tails out of the vehicle.

levels.1: Damage does not empty the counter uniformly.
levels.2: Carry rings and note the thirty- or fifty-ring loss after contact.
levels.3: Ordinary damage removes a fixed block rather than every ring, but pits, drowning, crushing, and timeout remain lethal. Preserve at least fifty before an emerald box and one during extended mechanical encounters.

levels.1: A large ring reserve has a direct reward.
levels.2: Raise the counter to 100 during any normal act.
levels.3: Collect the hundredth ring without dying or spending the route on a one-use box first. The extra life is awarded immediately; later rings begin building the next hundred normally.

levels.1: The act exit can display several outcomes.
levels.2: Cross Act 1 or Act 2 turnstiles and watch the symbol.
levels.3: Record the ring award and both character-life awards as they appear across replays. Some symbols give no resource. Do not mistake the randomized panel for an ending requirement or emerald state.

levels.1: The hidden box only works with a prepared ring count.
levels.2: Reach an emerald box with at least fifty rings.
levels.3: Do not break the box below fifty: each placement works once and becomes a Super Ring afterward. With fifty or more, break it and touch the star circle above it to enter the current uncleared Special Stage.

areas.name: Great Turquoise Zone
areas.location_cue: bright tropical ruins, tree springs, and shallow pools
areas.note: Use tree springs for the high line and treat the water route as an optional detour.

save_backup.title: Preserve both Great Turquoise Zone emerald windows
save_backup.why: Each emerald box becomes spent after it is broken, even when the ring requirement was not met.
save_backup.detail: Save at each act start and again with fifty rings before approaching the box. Keep separate Sonic and Tails route states.

point_of_no_return.title: Do not cross the Act 2 turnstile yet
point_of_no_return.why: Leaving the act closes both emerald-box opportunities in this area for the current route.
point_of_no_return.detail: Confirm both box locations are documented and the intended Special Stage is complete before ending Act 2; otherwise restore or replay.

levels.2: Finish Great Turquoise Zone Act 1 as Sonic without using level select.
levels.3: Stay high over the trees, then continue right through the open terrain.

areas.name: Special Stage 1
areas.location_cue: a pale temple maze with curved walls, pillars, clocks, and opposing springs
areas.note: A failed attempt repeats this same stage at the next unused emerald box; success advances the sequence.

save_backup.title: Back up before Special Stage 1
save_backup.why: Failure spends the current act's emerald box even though the same stage remains uncleared.
save_backup.detail: Save with fifty rings before breaking the box. On failure, restore for another attempt or deliberately continue to a later unused box.

levels.1: Use a prepared emerald-box window rather than opening it early.
levels.2: Carry fifty rings to any unused emerald box and touch its star circle.
levels.3: The cartridge always opens the earliest uncleared Special Stage. If this number does not appear, an earlier stage remains incomplete; restore that box state or use a later unused placement.

levels.1: Reach the end before time expires, using clocks to restore the full allowance.
levels.2: Complete Special Stage 1 and collect its emerald.

Climb the marked spring pillar, roll along the floor through the circular blocks to keep the recessed clock, collect the next room's rings before its clock, leave by the ground tunnel, cross the sideways springs slowly, then Air Roll right from the final diagonal spring.

levels.3: Climb the invisible sequence centre-right-centre-left-centre-right-centre, jump left, ride up, and take the clock. At the bumper field, drop through the hole under the tall red waterfall without spinning and land on the fragile block. Jump immediately after launching a Spin Dash through the three walls, climb the shaft without breaking its stepping blocks, cross the single-use bumpers, and enter the right corridor. Dodge the drill, strike exactly as it meets the floor, then land roughly six follow-up hits.

areas.name: Completion Branches
areas.location_cue: the late transport complex, its compact mechanical sequence, and the route-completion presentation
areas.note: Record both emerald-state outcomes for both playable characters without describing their story imagery in the guide.

save_backup.title: Keep four labelled completion states
save_backup.why: Character and emerald state jointly determine which completion presentation is recorded.
save_backup.detail: Preserve Sonic-standard, Sonic-complete, Tails-standard, and Tails-complete states before the late mechanical act.

point_of_no_return.title: Stop before the Atomic Destroyer Act 2 turnstile
point_of_no_return.why: No emerald boxes remain after this act, so the full-set branch cannot be repaired within the same route.
point_of_no_return.detail: Confirm all five Special Stage emeralds before crossing for a complete-set run. Restore an earlier box state if any is missing.

levels.1: One Sonic state should preserve an incomplete emerald set.
levels.2: Finish the route as Sonic without all five Special Stage emeralds.
levels.3: Use a dedicated Sonic state, leave at least one Special Stage uncleared, finish the late mechanical sequence, and record the standard completion presentation. Do not overwrite the complete-set state.

levels.1: A second Sonic state needs every optional emerald first.
levels.2: Finish the route as Sonic after clearing all five Special Stages.
levels.3: Confirm five emeralds before ending Atomic Destroyer Act 2. Complete Act 3; the sixth emerald is then awarded mechanically, and the distinct complete-set presentation and credits must be allowed to finish.

levels.1: Keep one Tails route below the full emerald threshold.
levels.2: Finish the route as Tails without all five Special Stage emeralds.
levels.3: Use a separate Tails state, deliberately leave at least one stage uncleared, complete the mechanical route, and record the standard presentation before restoring the full-set branch.

levels.1: The alternate character can earn the full set too.
levels.2: Finish the route as Tails after clearing all five Special Stages.
levels.3: Verify five emeralds before the last normal-act turnstile, finish the following mechanical sequence, receive the sixth emerald, and let Tails's complete-set presentation and credits run to completion.

areas.name: Hidden Cartridge Modes
areas.location_cue: the title screen, its alternate prompts, the dedicated practice course, and the character selector
areas.note: Demonstrate the cartridge's built-in secrets after the four legitimate completion routes are safely preserved.

levels.1: The title prompt has an alternate audio menu.
levels.2: At the title screen, use the directional input until Sound Test appears.
levels.3: Enter the menu and play every selectable number long enough to distinguish it, recording both ends of the range. Return with Start; do not treat compilation-specific controls as cartridge controls.

levels.1: A standalone course is hidden beside the audio menu.
levels.2: Select Time Attack from the alternate title prompt, then choose Sonic.
levels.3: Finish the unique mixed-theme course from its normal start and allow the result to return to the title. Record the completed time; level select does not substitute for this dedicated mode.

levels.1: The hidden course supports the other character separately.
levels.2: Select Time Attack again and choose Tails.
levels.3: Clear the same dedicated course using Tails's own movement and record the time through its normal result. Keep this separate from Sonic's demonstration.

levels.1: A power-on input changes the post-intro character route.
levels.2: Hold Up while powering on, then press Start as the third emerald is collected in the intro.
levels.3: Keep Up held from boot, time Start to the third intro pickup, and choose a character. Confirm the zone selector appears and load one early act only as a code demonstration; legitimate route clears remain separate.

levels.1: The untouched title screen contains a self-running sample.
levels.2: Leave the title screen idle until the demonstration begins.
levels.3: Record one complete attract cycle from title to its automatic return without controller input. This is presentation content, not evidence of a player-cleared act.
